dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #No Marana or bad seeds here. Keep the Memory of Stone for Nara {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's your plan?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Ah, Golden Nara {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Aranakula is keeping the Memory of Stone for Nara {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #In this way, Nara {NICKNAME} will always recall, leaves of the Great Tree, breeze in the forest, and Aranakula, even after a long leave.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Nara Varuna will know about, the other Golden Nara, kept in the memories of Vana, when Nara Varuna comes back.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Arabalika...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Very brave, Arabalika, saying things like protect Vana, just like Aradasha.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: But Aranakula thinks, growing happy flowers in the garden, and spreading their songs among the trees, will also protect Vana.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Aranakula, not half as powerful as Arabalika. But, Aranakula works to be better than half of half of Arabalika.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Yes. Aranakula doesn't have enough power to keep the Memory of Stone, but Aranakula will work hard.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Thanks to the help of Golden Nara and Paimon, Viparyas are happier than ever before.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Viparyas...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Golden Nara, do you want to sing to Viparyas?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Aranakula wants to hear Golden Nara sing, and Viparyas will like Golden Nara's voice, too.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #But... Nara {NICKNAME} can't stay...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Goodbye, Nara {NICKNAME}, the Viparyas will stay with you.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Aranakula wants to keep the Memory of the Soil, for Nara {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Memory of the Soil?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Uh-huh, not like stones, soil is soft like cloud, and turns into all shapes.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Aranakula is going to make a Nara {NICKNAME} with the garden soil, so Nara {NICKNAME} is always with the Viparyas.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: They will be happy, too.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #And Nara Varuna will know how Nara {NICKNAME} looks like, when Nara Varuna comes back.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Aranakula should thank Nara {NICKNAME}, for helping so much.
